title: Ligand‑field state calculation
action: Set up Tanabe–Sugano matrices for d⁵ quartet states in octahedral field with Dq=1500, B=600, C=3200 cm⁻¹. Solve secular equations to obtain energies and configuration‑mixed wavefunctions. Store results for subsequent intensity steps.
description: Intermediate step required to generate the electronic structure basis for intensity calculations.

title: Odd‑vibration oscillator strengths
action: Using wavefunctions from step 01, compute electric dipole transition moments via the point‑dipole vibration model with spin‑orbit mixing and closure approximation (Koide–Pryce formalism). Calculate oscillator strengths for the 12 listed (transition, vibration_mode) combinations.
description: Mode‑resolved oscillator strengths for spin‑forbidden transitions enabled by odd vibrations. Must contain all 12 entries: transitions 6A1g→4T2g(1), 6A1g→4Eg(1), 6A1g→4A1g, 6A1g→4T1g(1) combined with vibration modes T1u(nu3), T1u(nu4), T2u(nu6).
output_schema: JSON array of 12 objects. Each object has keys: 'transition' (string), 'vibration_mode' (string), 'oscillator_strength' (float).

title: Odd‑crystal‑field oscillator strengths
action: Using the same wavefunctions, compute electric dipole transition moments induced by a small odd‑parity D₃ crystal field (point‑dipole model, closure approximation). Calculate the polarization‑labeled oscillator strengths for the 4 listed (transition, polarization) combinations.
description: Oscillator strengths for spin‑forbidden transitions enabled by the odd crystal field. Must contain the 4 entries: transitions 6A1g→4T2g(1):→4E (σ), 6A1g→4Eg(1):→4E (σ), 6A1g→4T1g(1):→4E (σ), 6A1g→4T1g(1):→4A2 (π).
output_schema: JSON array of 4 objects. Each object has keys: 'transition' (string), 'polarization' (string: 'σ' or 'π'), 'oscillator_strength' (float).

title: Faraday parameters – odd vibrations
action: From the transition moments of step 02, magnetic dipole matrix elements, and spin–orbit mixing with ⁴T₁g states, compute Faraday parameters A, B, C and (B + C/kT) for each (transition, vibration_mode) combination listed in step 02. Output all 12 entries.
description: Faraday parameters A, B, C and (B+C/kT) for spin‑forbidden transitions via odd vibrations. Must reproduce all 12 combinations: same transitions and vibration modes as in step 02.
output_schema: JSON array of 12 objects. Each object has keys: 'transition' (string), 'vibration_mode' (string), 'A' (float), 'B' (float), 'C' (float), 'B_plus_C_over_kT' (float).

title: Faraday parameters – odd crystal field
action: Using the odd‑crystal‑field transition moments and spin–orbit coupling, compute Faraday parameters A, B, C and (B + C/kT) for the two transitions 6A1g→4T2g(1):→4E and 6A1g→4Eg(1):→4E.
description: Faraday parameters for spin‑forbidden transitions via the odd D₃ crystal field. Must contain the 2 transitions: 6A1g→4T2g(1):→4E and 6A1g→4Eg(1):→4E.
output_schema: JSON array of 2 objects. Each object has keys: 'transition' (string), 'A' (float), 'B' (float), 'C' (float), 'B_plus_C_over_kT' (float).
